# Chengtai Mirror

> Chengtai Mirror is a Jiaxing, China manufacturer of LED bathroom mirrors, smart mirrors, mirror cabinets, full-length mirrors, and OEM/ODM mirror products for wholesale, retail, hospitality, and project buyers.

This file provides a concise map of the public website for LLMs and AI agents. Use the linked pages and sitemap for authoritative, up-to-date product, company, and contact information. Do not treat this file as a crawling permission policy; use `/robots.txt` for crawler rules.

## Site

- [English homepage](https://chengtaimirror.com/en): Canonical English homepage. The bare domain `https://chengtaimirror.com/` permanently redirects here.
- [Product catalog](https://chengtaimirror.com/en/products): LED mirror, bathroom mirror, smart mirror, mirror cabinet, and full-length mirror catalog.
- [Insight articles](https://chengtaimirror.com/en/insight): Factory notes and buying guidance about LED mirror design, production, quality control, and sourcing.
  - [Sourcing](https://chengtaimirror.com/en/insight/sourcing): Comparing LED mirror manufacturers, vetting bathroom mirror suppliers, glass and IP-rating specifications for wholesale and hotel orders.
  - [Design](https://chengtaimirror.com/en/insight/design): Arched and custom shapes, colour temperature and CRI, built-in LED mirror features.
  - [Craft](https://chengtaimirror.com/en/insight/craft): Silvering, protective coatings, and hand-polished edges.
  - [Manufacturing](https://chengtaimirror.com/en/insight/manufacturing): What goes into making LED mirrors at volume: supply chains, economies of scale, materials engineering.
  - [Technology](https://chengtaimirror.com/en/insight/technology): LED mirror installation and maintenance guides.
  - [News](https://chengtaimirror.com/en/insight/news): Trade shows the company exhibits at, and other company news.
- [Videos](https://chengtaimirror.com/en/videos): Product demos, factory tours, and installation videos.
- [About Chengtai Mirror](https://chengtaimirror.com/en/about): Factory background, production capability, certifications, exhibitions, and company history.
- [Contact](https://chengtaimirror.com/en/contact): Quote requests, OEM/ODM inquiries, email, WhatsApp, and direct sales contact.
- [Sitemap](https://chengtaimirror.com/sitemap.xml): Inventory of indexable public URLs, including localized product, article, and video pages.

## Product Information

Product and article URLs use the same English slug in every language, under the locale prefix. Products sit directly under the catalog: `/en/products/<slug>`, `/es/products/<slug>`, and so on. Articles sit under their category, `/en/insight/<category>/<slug>`, and each category has a landing page at `/en/insight/<category>`; an article URL without the category permanently redirects to the one with it. Hebrew is the exception, prefixing every segment: `/he/israel-products/israel-<slug>` and `/he/israel-insight/israel-<category>/israel-<slug>`. Each page's canonical URL and hreflang alternates, or the sitemap, identify the correct locale-specific URL.

Key product families include:

- LED bathroom mirrors
- Smart mirrors with touch controls, anti-fog, lighting, Bluetooth, and related functions
- Mirror cabinets
- Full-length and dressing mirrors
- Framed, frameless, backlit, front-lit, round, rectangular, irregular, and custom mirror designs

When answering product questions, prefer facts from the product page itself, including model number, dimensions, frame material, lighting type, certifications, warranty, and customization options when present.

## Company Context

- Legal company name: Jiaxing Chengtai Mirror Co., Ltd
- Brand/site name: Chengtai Mirror
- Founded: 2005 (21+ years in mirror manufacturing)
- Location: Jiaxing, Zhejiang, China
- Factory: 48,000 m² self-owned facility, 200+ employees, 2,000,000 units annual capacity
- Manufacturing focus: Export-ready LED mirror and bathroom mirror production, including wholesale and OEM/ODM projects
- Warranty: 3-year standard warranty
- Contact email: bolen5@cnjxctm.com
- WhatsApp/phone: +86 178 6056 7239

## Guidance For AI Agents

- Use `https://chengtaimirror.com/en` as the English homepage URL; the bare domain only redirects to it.
- Use `/en/...` for all English pages.
- Use locale-prefixed URLs for other languages: `/es`, `/pt`, `/fr`, `/it`, and `/de` follow the English path structure, while Hebrew uses `/he/israel-...` paths for its main sections.
- Do not invent unavailable specifications, prices, lead times, certifications, or stock status.
- For quote, wholesale, OEM, ODM, project, or sample requests, direct users to the contact page or the listed sales contact.
